title: Every backend answers the same operations the same way
description:
As the app, I want every backend to behave identically, so that the same code works on AWS, in Swift and on the local server.

```gherkin
Feature: Amplify-shaped operations everywhere
  Scenario Outline: The same operation gives the same answer on every backend
    Given the <backend> backend with an empty library
    And I am user "local" in groups "members", "curators"
    When I create a Crate {"name": "digs"}
    And I list all Crate
    Then data holds one Crate named "digs" whose owner is set

    Examples:
      | backend |
      | engine  |
      | serve   |
      | sandbox |
```
The full corpus is `features/data/` (task apricitus-22f006).
